usedFor: ZenCommerce holds your store orders, and HubSpot keeps the customer record when “New Order Created” runs “Add Notes to Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order Created” in ZenCommerce, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new order leaves a note on the buyer’s HubSpot contact, so sales sees the purchase.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, so the buyer must already exist in HubSpot.
